product_overview: MedFlow is a multi-tenant backend API for clinical and financial operations (appointments, patients, staff, medical records, finance and PDF reports) with tenant isolation (RLS) and JWT cookie-based authentication.
core_goals: Provide secure multi-tenant isolation (tenant context + RLS) so no data leaks across tenants
Deliver cookie-based JWT authentication with refresh rotation and role-based access control
Support core clinical workflows: appointments, patients, staff/procedures and PEP (medical records)
Provide full financial lifecycle: transactions, box/closure flows, medical-fee repasses and PDF reports
Expose validated, auditable endpoints with DTO validation and OWASP-safe defaults (secure HttpOnly cookies, input validation)

features.name: Multi-tenant security (RLS + tenant context)
features.description: Enforce tenant isolation using tenant middleware + Prisma tenant context and DB RLS; all requests must carry tenant context (x-tenant-slug or token tenantId).
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid credentials and x-tenant-slug header -> Receive 200 with HttpOnly access_token & refresh_token cookies and user payload containing tenantId -> GET /auth/me with cookies and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 200 with user context where tenantId matches x-tenant-slug -> GET /finance/boxes/status with cookies and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 200 with balances scoped to that tenant only
GET /patients with valid cookies but x-tenant-slug of another tenant -> Receive 403 Forbidden (or empty result) preventing cross-tenant data access
GET /appointments without x-tenant-slug and token lacking tenantId -> Receive 400 Bad Request (tenant context missing) -> Client must resend request with x-tenant-slug

features.name: Auth with JWT cookies
features.description: Login issues HttpOnly access and refresh cookies; support refresh rotation, logout (clear cookies) and me endpoint to return user/staff context and roles.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid email/password -> Receive 200 with HttpOnly access_token and refresh_token cookies set (secure in prod) and JSON body with user summary -> GET /auth/me with cookies -> Receive 200 with user payload including role and staffId when applicable -> POST /auth/logout with cookies -> Receive 200 and Set-Cookie clearing auth cookies
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error body (no cookies set)
POST /auth/refresh with valid refresh_token cookie -> Receive 200 with rotated access_token and refresh_token cookies -> GET /auth/me with new access cookie -> Receive 200
POST /auth/refresh with missing or expired refresh_token cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (client must re-login)

features.name: Appointments (scheduling & status)
features.description: Create, read, update, delete appointments and update status (confirmed, cancelled, completed) while respecting schedule blocks and tenant isolation.
user_flows: POST /appointments with valid access cookie and { patientId, staffId, startTime, endTime, procedureId } (ISO8601 for times) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with created appointment object -> GET /appointments/:id with access cookie -> Receive 200 with appointment details -> PATCH /appointments/:id/status with status=confirmed -> Receive 200 with updated status
POST /appointments with valid cookie but appointment time overlapping an existing appointment -> Receive 409 Conflict with error explaining overlap
GET /appointments without authentication cookies -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Patients (CRUD)
features.description: Create and manage patient records; all operations are validated and scoped to tenant.
user_flows: POST /patients with valid access cookie and { name, cpf, phone, birthDate } (birthDate YYYY-MM-DD, cpf unique per tenant) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with patient id -> GET /patients/:id with access cookie -> Receive 200 with patient record -> PUT /patients/:id with { name, cpf, phone, birthDate } -> Receive 200 with updated record
GET /patients/:id with valid cookie but non-existent id -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /patients with invalid payload (missing required fields) -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Staff & Procedures (team management and procedure linkage)
features.description: Manage staff/professionals and procedures; support linking procedures to staff (skills/offerings).
user_flows: POST /staff with admin access cookie and staff DTO and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with staff id -> POST /procedures with admin cookie and { name, grossAmount } (NOT code/description/price) -> Receive 201 with procedure id -> POST /staff/:staffId/procedures with { procedureId } and access cookie -> Receive 200 with staff procedures list updated
POST /staff/:staffId/procedures with non-existent procedureId -> Receive 404 Not Found
DELETE /staff/:id with receptionist role cookie -> Receive 403 Forbidden (insufficient role) unless caller has ADMIN/OWNER role

features.name: PEP (SOAP medical records, finalize, addendums)
features.description: Create and manage patient PEP records (SOAP notes), allow finalize action and addendums; all changes are tenant-scoped and validated.
user_flows: POST /pep with valid access cookie and { appointmentId, patientId, staffId } (optional: soapSubjective, soapObjective, soapAssessment, soapPlan) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with pepId -> POST /pep/:id/finalize with access cookie -> Receive 200 with finalized flag -> POST /pep/:id/addendum with { content } and access cookie -> Receive 201 with addendum attached
POST /pep/:id/finalize with missing required sign-off fields -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors
GET /pep/:id with access cookie for different tenant -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Finance & Reports (transactions, boxes, closures, medical-fee repasses, PDFs)
features.description: Track transactions, compute daily balances by payment method, close cashier boxes (receptionist/admin), close medical-fee repasses and generate PDF reports for closures and medical-fee repasses.
user_flows: POST /finance/transactions with access cookie and { type, category, amount } (type: income|expense) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with transaction id -> GET /finance/boxes/status with access cookie -> Receive 200 with income/expense totals by method -> POST /finance/boxes/receptionist/close with { date, initialBalance, finalBalance } (date YYYY-MM-DD) and access cookie -> Receive 201 with closureId -> GET /reports/daily-closure/:closureId with access cookie -> Receive 200 with application/pdf bytes (PDF closure report)
POST /finance/medical-fees/close with access cookie and incomplete payment payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request (validation error) and no closure generated
GET /reports/daily-closure/:closureId with valid cookie but closure belongs to another tenant -> Receive 403 Forbidden (report access denied)

features.name: Schedule (config & blocks)
features.description: Manage schedule configuration and blocking time ranges (vacations, unavailable slots) for staff; validation prevents overlapping blocks.
user_flows: POST /schedule/blocks with access cookie and { staffId, blockType, startDate } (blockType: date|period, startDate/endDate YYYY-MM-DD) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with block id -> GET /schedule with access cookie -> Receive 200 with schedule and blocks
POST /schedule/blocks creating an overlapping block for same staff -> Receive 409 Conflict (overlap detected)
GET /schedule without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Suppliers (CRUD)
features.description: Manage supplier records used by the clinic (CRUD) with tenant scoping.
user_flows: POST /suppliers with access cookie and { name } (optional: contactInfo) and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 201 with supplier id -> GET /suppliers/:id with access cookie -> Receive 200 with supplier details -> PUT /suppliers/:id with updated DTO -> Receive 200
DELETE /suppliers/:id with access cookie where id does not exist -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Expense Categories (tree CRUD)
features.description: Maintain hierarchical expense categories for finance classification; support listing as a tree and CRUD operations with validation to prevent cycles.
user_flows: GET /expense-categories with access cookie and x-tenant-slug -> Receive 200 with categories tree -> POST /expense-categories with access cookie and { name, parentId } -> Receive 201 with category id -> PUT /expense-categories/:id with access cookie -> Receive 200 updated node
POST /expense-categories with parentId that would create a cycle -> Receive 400 Bad Request (validation prevents cycle)
